headline: 59 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Second Flat Fire in OR, threatening 832 structures.

active_threats.name: Second Flat
active_threats.narrative: The Second Flat Fire in Harney County, OR has burned 105,854 acres and is 99% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **832 structures threatened**. 2 personnel are assigned. A forecast wind read wasn't available for this fire today.

active_threats.name: Three Queens
active_threats.narrative: The Three Queens Fire in Kittitas County, WA has burned 9,582 acres and is 33% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **191 structures threatened**. 29 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 6 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (N, blowing toward the S) favors pushing the fire toward Easton CDP, 13 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over CA, NV: Reno city, Carson City, South Lake Tahoe city, Spanish Springs CDP, and Truckee town and 9 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 3,4). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 8% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
